content: No Theia-specific NixOS reports found directly; general findings transfer: (1) Electron apps on NixOS commonly hit the 'SUID sandbox helper binary... not configured correctly' error because NixOS doesn't have a standard FHS /tmp/electron-chrome-sandbox setuid path -- fixed via nixpkgs' electron wrapper (chrome-sandbox setuid wrapper) or --no-sandbox flag (not for production) or buildFHSUserEnv. (2) node-gyp/native-module builds against system glibc can break outside nix-shell/direct nix build isolation -- use nix-ld or a proper Nix devShell with the needed native build inputs (python3, pkg-config, standard C toolchain) rather than the ambient host toolchain.
